notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
[h2]🌵 Desolate Plateau (endless) Adjustments[/h2]
- Difficulty of the first ~30 waves has been lowered
- Music now changes every 10 nights

[h2]🥇 Friends Leaderboard[/h2]
- Every location now shows highscores of your Steam friends
- Campaign locations show how much time it took to complete the location
- Desolate Plateau (endless) shows how many nights the player managed to survive

[h2]🔨 Improvements[/h2]
- Fade-in and fade-out animations have been added to the tooltips

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042573/1868c478c51a63b1e25a8bf9f92b61b975b6721e.png[/img]

[h2]Campaign overhaul[/h2]

[list]
[*] Campaign has been split into 3 parts (locations)
[*] Blueprints from previous location are available in the next one from start
[*] Separate location for endless mode has been added
[/list]

[h2]Complete re-balancing[/h2]

[list]
[*] Amount of XP required to earn upgrade points on higher levels has been reduced
[*] Exploration
  - Chance to find a PoI in the fog has been increased
  - Number of cells explored with Explore card has been increased to 2 (3 for Explorer)
[*] Ossuary and altars
  - Amount of skulls required by altars has been reduced
  - Altar buffs: Altar - Bounty, Altar - Repair, Altar - Anatomy
  - Skull price has been increased to 2 gold
[*] Upgrades
  - Town Gate upgrades now reduce repair cost during the day
  - Immobilizing Shot, Searing Shot, Explosive Formula upgrades now become active immediately, no need to purchase them in the Laboratory
  - Buffs: Searing Shot, Explosive Formula, Spikes
[*] In-game Upgrades
  - Prices are reduced for: Laboratory and its upgrades, Library and its upgrades, Town Gate upgrades, Spikes, Last Resort, Mortar Tower specs, Raised Platform
  - Laboratory - Burn upgrade has been buffed and no longer scales with Cannon Tower damage
[*] Some of the monster changes
  - Bosses are less tanky but have more speed and deal more damage
  - Overall buffs: Arsonist, Ghoul, Archer, Bomber, Arbalist
  - Overall nerfs: Glutton, Battering Ram, Knight
  - Auras: Dissipation aura has been buffed, Protection aura has been nerfed
[/list]

[h2]Steam cloud saves[/h2]

[list]
[*] Game progress is now saved to Steam cloud and can be transferred between machines as well as between Windows and Linux
[/list]

[h2]Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] General
  - Frame rate drops caused by some of the assets being lazy-loaded for the first time are fixed
  - Altars now show an indicator when an upgrade becomes available
  - Number of upgrade points has been made always visible on the Upgrades screen
  - Purchasing a defense tower upgrade requiring population now shows "-X population" text above the Gold Mine
  - Searing shot now has its own unique battle text
  - Result screen has been animated
  - Status card - game speed translation issue has been fixed
  - Issue with XP bar getting stuck at full for a moment after receiving an upgrade point has been fixed
  - Treasure I PoI battle text position has been fixed
  - Flag height of a defense tower on a raised platform has been fixed
[*] Sound
  - New sounds: tree destruction, double gold drop (Luck Totem), Tactician reward, 2nd repair sound, Refinery upgrade, Armory upgrade, Laboratory upgrade, Library upgrade, Watch Tower shooter upgrade, Cannon Tower upgrade, Mortar Tower upgrade
  - Sounds moved to 3D space: tree sounds, PoI sounds, demolish sound, exploration sound, gate reinforce and repair, building sounds, gold sounds
[/list]

[h2]Achievements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Role-based achievements are now granted for completing any location for specific role
[*] Tower-based achievements are now granted for defeating Titan using specific tower, you can use any tower for monsters other than Titan
[/list]

[b]Thank you for your feedback![/b]

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Add buttons to speed up time
[*] Increase number of points of interest hidden in the fog at the start of the game
[*] Display information about new monsters in the morning
[*] Bind [i]Tab[/i] key to switch focus between towers of the same type
[*] Show help messages on loading screen and pause menu
[*] Warn about upcoming boss fights - "Blood moon" nights
[*] Change [i]Combustion[/i] mechanic: reduce interval between hits instead of less hits and more damage
[*] Lower the amount of skulls required by altars, reduce [i]Ossuary[/i] capacity
[*] Nerf [i]Grave Digger[/i]. Buff [i]Archer[/i], [i]Bomber[/i] and [i]Arbalist[/i]
[*] Nerf [i]Mortar Tower Shockwave[/i] upgrade
[*] Upgrade to Godot v4.3
[*] Other bug fixes and balance tweaks
[/list]
